findings.finding: Report compares aligned Level2 Io pairs with different short commanded exposures; two residual criteria estimate a constant exposure offset. This method and source imagery are not reprocessed here.

Reported Io MET pairs34966574/34966577 and35029094/35029097 use4/20ms reported exposures. First pair criteria yield0.59/0.58ms; second0.59ms. Slide4 difference-image label uses4.58/20.58ms despite prose0.59ms for the standard-deviation minimum; distinct criteria are retained. These are not Elara MET35398319/35398320.

Authors adopt+0.6ms and report a pipeline update to exposure-header keywords. Their method is less reliable for much longer exposures; their statement about typical Pluto/Arrokoth flyby exposures is not an independent Elara photometric-error assessment.

Simplified timing explanation distinguishes software-assumed13ms scrub from FPGA12.384ms scrub and11.546ms transfer; reported mechanism gives0.616ms additional exposure. These are publisher values, not independently reproduced flight timing; rounded adopted0.6ms remains distinct.
